description:
We often treat promises to others as a must, while treating promises to ourselves as optional.

And that’s one of the biggest mistakes we can make.

Just think for a second: what does that do to your confidence?

Does it make you feel like you can trust yourself? Like you can rely on yourself?

And at the end of the day, you probably still beat yourself up for not following through, which only makes you feel worse.

Start small. Don’t make too many promises to yourself. But when you do make one, keep it.

Because every promise you keep to yourself builds trust in yourself.
transcript: If you have a touch deadline tomorrow, you are going to do that. If you have a client deadline tomorrow, you are going to do that. If your boss say, be there at nine or I'm going to fire you, you'll be there tomorrow at nine. But if you say to yourself, I'm going to read that book, I'm going to work out, I'm going to post, this may not happen. Why? Because one is a must and second is an option. But here is the thing. These optional things that you promise to yourself are the things that actually can change your life. Even if no one is going to chase you if you're not going to work out tomorrow. So make the promises to yourself worth something and you will see your life changing. And if you want to have a big change in your life, follow me and let's do this together.
